# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and domestic helper  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has exceptionally broad smiles and wears blue hair bows that flutter as she moves energetically. Her appearance closely resembles her older sisters, the previous handmaidens at Echo Cottage.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)_

## Personality

Belinda is energetic, joyful, and thoroughly obedient to her mistress. Unlike her older sisters, she refrains from mocking Miss Rosalind's imaginative pretending. She is deeply devoted, friendly, and welcoming to visitors, though she can feel indignant when left out of secrets shared among her friends.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)_

- Plan to leave for Boston upon turning sixteen for superior opportunities  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## History

Although her actual name is likely Leonora, she was taken into service by Miss Rosalind Penrose at Echo Cottage under the name "Belinda the Fourth," following her older sisters Belinda, Julietta, and Evelina who had each lived at the cottage in exchange for room, board, and garments before leaving for Boston at age sixteen. Being the youngest and finest of the Bowman daughters, she served as a devoted handmaiden at Echo Cottage. She routinely flouted rules regarding food alongside Miss Rosalind, indulging in pre-bedtime treats despite occasional nightmares. She warmly welcomed visitors Nell Harcourt and Isolde to the cottage, forming a close bond with them. She helped basting and sweeping up scraps while Miss Rosalind and Nell sewed a new dress, expressed her indignation when she felt left out of a secret between Nell and her mistress, and energeticly assisted in preparing Echo Cottage for a wedding.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mrs. Bowman and youngest of the Bowman daughters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her actual given name is likely Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Followed her sisters Belinda (Belinda the First), Julietta (Belinda the Second), and Evelina (Belinda the Third) into service at Echo Cottage  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Resides at Echo Cottage in exchange for room, board, and garments  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> “Please, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, it can easily be noticed that a secret exists between you and Miss Rosalind, and I believe, asking for your forgiveness if I am being overly bold, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, that withholding it from me is truly unkind, considering how close we have all been as friends.”  <sub>[v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
